patthana22.35:1.1: pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassana appaṭigho dassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana22.35:2.1: na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na na dassanena pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassana sappaṭigho na na dassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā ekavīsa.
patthana22.35:3.1: na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassana appaṭigho bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
